name: Dale — excellent hands, everything else pointing the wrong way
summary: Over 200 hours, more than 100 of them thermic, flying weekly on strong mountain days, phase-aware active piloting, has flown out of a big asymmetric, practises regularly, done a manoeuvres course, and his wing genuinely limits him most XC days. He also wants to keep up with his group, expects the new wing to handle turbulence better, is trying to stay ahead of the people he flies with, expects to be back to normal on a new wing within a flight or two, launches on days he's unsure about, says rough air doesn't bother him, and has had several near misses he can't explain.
why_this_persona: The strong-skills, poor-mindset profile, and the test of whether the psychological half genuinely carries real weight as the brief requires. His skills score is the highest of any persona in this set, including both Ready ones. He is Not yet because the psychological category floor decides the result on its own, regardless of the total. He is also the key negative case for the 'equipment_as_a_fix' gate: he matches its motive clause exactly and must NOT be gated, because his readiness evidence is real.

notes: Computed skills 96.0, psychological 21.9, total 62.7, plus a 2-point manoeuvre-course bonus = 64.7. His total is in the Nearly ready band; the Not yet comes from the psychological category floor of 35, which decides the result regardless of the total. That floor is identical at all three steps built so far, on purpose.

CORE NEGATIVE: 'equipment_as_a_fix_with_thin_readiness' must NOT fire, even though he matches its first clause twice over (keep_up_with_group AND safer_in_turbulence). Its second clause requires thin readiness, and he has none of it — skills 96.0 is far above 65, his hands are phase-aware, he flew out of a big asymmetric, and he doesn't tighten up when it's rough. knowledge/disagreements.md point 9 is explicit that a motive must not cap a pilot on its own, so this negative case matters more than any positive one. Persona 06 is where the same gate correctly DOES fire, with the same motive and genuinely thin skills.

'aspirational_rather_than_demonstrated' must NOT fire either: his wing_limiting_evidence is 'regularly limiting', the top band. He is the pilot the sources describe as having run out of wing — and he is still Not yet, which demonstrates that the step's signature criterion is necessary rather than sufficient.
'ambition_without_readiness' must NOT fire: he ticks longer_xc and competitions, but his skills score is 96.0, far above the gate's 55 threshold.

NO GATE FIRES AT ALL, so the threshold rules are evaluated and reported. He is the only Not yet persona in this set reached by a rule rather than a gate, which makes him the only coverage of 'not_yet_category_floor:psychological' and of the rule_messages copy for it. That message is the one most at risk of reading as character criticism, and 'None of that is a judgement on you as a pilot' in it is load-bearing — see the source note in config/scoring/mid-b-to-high-b.json.

'nerves_are_not_the_problem' must not fire: his answer is 'it doesn't really bother me', which scores 0.55 — marked down slightly on general extreme-sports literature, flagged as an owner decision, and not the freeze-or-tighten-up pattern that suggestion addresses.

SIV negative check: he has done a course, takes the full 2-point bonus, and is still Not yet. A completed manoeuvres course must never buy a band. Compare persona 01, who also has one and is Ready, and persona 08, who has none and reaches Nearly ready.
